event: Bank Indonesia cut the average bank reserve requirement (GWM) by 2 percentage points alongside holding the BI-Rate and extending the LTV/FTV property-loan policy, while the rupiah still weakened. (update of E0221)
key_numbers: GWM conventional banks 9% to 7% · sharia banks and units 7.5% to 5.5% · rupiah closed Rp18,060/USD on 22 Oct, down 38 points (0.21%) from Rp18,022 · SBN yields 5Y 7.21%, 10Y 7.43%, 15Y 7.42%, 20Y 7.41% · bond volume Rp24.39 T

event: The rupiah closed Friday 23 October at Rp18,067 per USD, 0.01% weaker, and analysts see it testing Rp18,200 next week with oil prices as the main risk. (update of E0222)
key_numbers: Rupiah Rp18,067/USD (-0.01%) on 23 Oct · forecast Rp18,200 for week of 26 Oct (Bisnis headline) · IHSG 5,439.26 on 23 Oct

event: BEI said the MSCI proposal to move Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone is only a consultation, not a final decision, and that it will ask MSCI to clarify the basis for the announcement. (update of E0120)
key_numbers: Consultation runs to 30 Apr 2027 · MSCI announced 15 Oct 2026 · HSC stocks excluded from IHSG from 2 Nov 2026

event: PDI-P executive Deddy Sitorus replies to the Gibran volunteer group Relawan Militan Gibran 08 Nusantara, saying PDI-P has moved on from 2024 and only discusses Jokowi's family as a case study on betrayal, after PDI-P called the VP diploma row a burden on the government.
key_numbers: Published 25 Oct 2026 08:50 WIB · volunteer chair Andi Azwan statement 24 Oct · 2 years of the Prabowo-Gibran government

event: BPK member (Anggota VI) Fathan Subchi, a former two-term PKB DPR member, has died, according to an announcement by PKB DPP.
key_numbers: Announced Sun 25 Oct 2026 · DPR member 2014-2024 · cause and age not stated

event: Former TNI Commander Adm. (Ret.) Widodo Adi Sutjipto is buried with a military ceremony at Kalibata heroes' cemetery, attended by SBY, Defense Minister Sjafrie and TNI Commander Agus Subiyanto.
key_numbers: Burial 25 Oct 2026, 13:30 WIB · TNI Commander 1999-2002 · Menko Polhukam 2004-2009

event: DPR Commission III deputy chair Ahmad Sahroni (NasDem) backs Luhut's proposal that state loss should not count as corruption and urges a revision of the Tipikor Law; KPK chair Setyo Budiyanto on 21 Oct said the state-loss element must stay. (update of E0231)
key_numbers: Luhut met Prabowo 20 Oct 2026 · Sahroni 22 Oct · KPK response 21 Oct · UNCAC ratified via UU 7/2006 · KPK says four UNCAC offences still need provisions

event: Komdigi, at a Jakarta discussion, asked platforms to label AI-generated content and be transparent about AI agents after the Threads account @IbuAsihLaundry went viral as a suspected AI bot that pro-Prabowo/MBG posts.
key_numbers: Komdigi session 22 Oct 2026 · account allegedly named model 'Muse Spark' (Meta) and posted an Anthropic API-credit error · Komdigi: bot use alone is not a violation · expert Alfons Tanujaya: neat writing/high posting frequency does not prove AI

event: Komdigi asked Meta to clarify after Meta.ai told users that karhutla content was restricted at Komdigi's request; Komdigi says it does not restrict or shadowban karhutla content.
key_numbers: Komdigi remarks 22 Oct, reported 23 Oct 2026 · Menkomdigi denial video 21 Oct · Meta had not replied at publication · cites Surat Edaran Menkomdigi 9/2023 on AI ethics · draft Perpres on AI ethics and National AI Roadmap 2026-2029 in preparation

event: The PHP2Shell flaw disrupted sites worldwide as operators took pages offline to patch, including Japan's ANA, JR West and MUFG, several European government sites and Wikimedia systems; in Indonesia the Ministry of Industry (Kemenperin) temporarily shut its site. (update of E0239)
key_numbers: 2 critical PHP flaws · PHP runs ~70% of websites · Wiz compares impact to Heartbleed (2014) · advisory 21 Oct, outages 22-23 Oct 2026 · Kemenperin shutdown per Bisnis headline 24 Oct (body not read)

event: Counterpoint Research data reported by Bisnis.com show global PC shipments fell 21% y/y in Q3 2026 because DRAM and NAND memory costs pushed laptop prices up and buyers delayed purchases.
key_numbers: 57 million units in Q3 2026 (-21% y/y) · Lenovo 15 m (26.3%) · HP 10.3 m (18.1%) · Dell 7.6 m (13.3%) · Apple ~5.6 m laptops (-11%, 9.8% share) · Asus 5.2 m (+19.4% q/q) · Counterpoint sees Q4 down again, up to -27% for full 2026, flat 2027

event: Kemenekraf games director Luat Sihombing said rising chip and RAM prices are squeezing Indonesia's game industry and that the ministry is preparing incentives and a revision of Perpres 19/2024.
key_numbers: Chip and RAM prices rising for 2 years · games could add up to US$3.3 bn (~Rp59 T) to GDP by 2030 · ~476,600 jobs by 2030 vs ~257,400 now (Tencent/Access Partnership white paper) · stated at WCCE 2026, 22 Oct

event: Malaysia bars civil servants from using Waze on official matters over fears that data could leak to Israel, per detik and CNBC Indonesia.
key_numbers: Report dated 24 Oct 2026 · applies to ASN/PNS · reason: data-leak concern (Israel link) as reported

event: Police data presented to Prabowo show 243 individuals and 13 corporations (CNN Indonesia headline says 14) named karhutla suspects, with licence revocation recommended in 23 corporate cases. (update of E0213)
key_numbers: 243 individual suspects from 286 reports (5,856 ha) · 13 corporate suspects from 100 reports (29,534.99 ha) · 23 corporate cases recommended for licence revocation · 11 suspect corporations hold 209,933 ha of concessions, 11,105.39 ha burned (8 in West Kalimantan, 2 Central, 1 South) · 22 corporations linked to foreign investment · data as of 20 Oct 18:00 WIB

event: CNBC Indonesia reports NASA flagging very high 2026 fire activity in Kalimantan and Papua, with Indonesian Papua emissions the third-highest on record. (update of E0021)
key_numbers: Indonesian Papua emissions >35 million tons carbon (3rd after 2015, 1997) · PNG ~32 million tons through 17 Oct · Papua primary forest loss 27,000 ha in 2025 (~2x 2024) · rains expected early Nov

key_numbers: 1.16 tons ketamine · Rp3.48 trillion estimated value · 8 crew detained · ship reportedly turned off AIS

event: A BYD electric car crashed into several vehicles and ran over online motorcycle-taxi driver Hasan Syukur on Jalan Panglima Polim, Blok M, South Jakarta; the driver, identified as S, was named a suspect on 25 Oct.

key_numbers: 33.2 million recipients (deciles 1-4) · 30 kg per recipient for 3 months (10 kg/month) · about 1 million tons of rice
